_meta.description: Every AM/FM station that a Section 1-3 game is carried on in the San Francisco Bay Area, focused on the Outer Sunset (94122). Reception notes are deliberately conservative: only facility facts (power, class, city of license) that were read from a source this pass are asserted, and anything unverified is marked NEEDS_MANUAL_CHECK rather than guessed.
_meta.why_this_matters: A game counts as busy only if it is reachable on a standard radio. This file is the audit trail for that assumption.
_meta.regulatory_note: County-by-county AM/FM reception cannot be proven from documents. Nothing here claims a measured field strength; see docs/LIMITATIONS-NEXT.md.
